title: Premier Projects for Food Trading and Services | Qatar

hero.eyebrow: Established 2026 · Doha, Qatar · Multi-sector Trading & Services
hero.headline: Building Partnerships. Delivering Quality. Creating Value.
hero.lead: Premier Projects for Food Trading and Services is a diversified trading and services company established in 2026 as a sister company of Premier Catering Services. Under the leadership and supervision of Mr. Abdulla Saoud O H Al Mana, the group has expanded beyond catering into multiple commercial sectors in Qatar and international markets.

about.lead: Premier Projects for Food Trading and Services was established with a clear vision: to build a diversified business platform capable of serving multiple industries with dependable products, competitive solutions and professional services.
about.summary: As a sister company of Premier Catering Services, we benefit from the experience and business foundation developed by the group over the years. Our objective is to develop long-term relationships with customers, suppliers, contractors and business partners by consistently delivering quality, value and reliability.
about.vision: To become a trusted and diversified trading and services company in Qatar and the region, recognized for quality products, reliable services, strong partnerships and responsible business practices.
about.mission: To provide customers with reliable products, competitive pricing and professional services across multiple business sectors while developing dependable international supply networks and long-term customer relationships.

values: Source and supply products that meet customer requirements.
Build dependable supply and service relationships.
Conduct business with transparency and professionalism.
Build long-term relationships with customers and suppliers.
sectors: Food & Beverage Trading
Sourcing, importing, supplying and distributing selected dry, packaged, frozen and chilled foods, beverages, cooking ingredients, bulk food, catering supplies and FMCG products.
Automotive & Spare Parts
Automotive spare parts, tyres, batteries, lubricants, filters, engine components, maintenance products, commercial vehicle parts, workshop supplies and accessories.
Tyres
Tyre sourcing for passenger vehicles, SUVs, light commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, commercial vehicles and industrial applications from China, India, Thailand and other markets.
Batteries & Lubricants
Automotive and heavy-duty batteries, engine oils, gear oils, hydraulic oils, transmission fluids, greases, coolants and workshop lubricants.
Building Materials
Construction materials, hardware, electrical and plumbing materials, safety products, tools, equipment, finishing materials and general project supplies.
Cosmetics & Personal Care
Personal care, beauty, cosmetics, skin care, hair care, hygiene and general consumer products for Qatar and regional markets.
Import & Export
International sourcing and product movement connecting manufacturers and suppliers with customers in Qatar and beyond across multiple product categories.
General Trading & Supplies
Flexible sourcing solutions for companies, contractors, institutions and organizations, from everyday supplies to specialized commercial products.
Labour Supply & Project Services
Manpower and project-support solutions for selected industrial, construction, maintenance, inspection, technical and project-based requirements in accordance with applicable Qatar regulations.
Tenders & Contract Supply
Product sourcing, quotation preparation, tender supply, bulk procurement, contract supply, project-based procurement and import/delivery coordination.

automotive.intro: Our automotive division works with international suppliers to source products according to customer specifications and market requirements. The tyre business is being developed through established manufacturers and suppliers in China, India, Thailand and other international markets.

approach: We understand our customer's requirements and business objectives.
We identify suitable products and reliable suppliers.
We coordinate supply and delivery efficiently.
We remain responsive throughout the customer relationship.
We develop long-term partnerships that create value for both parties.

leadership.name: Mr. Abdulla Saoud O H Al Mana
leadership.body1: Under the leadership and supervision of Mr. Abdulla Saoud O H Al Mana, the group has pursued a strategy of business diversification and expansion across multiple sectors.
leadership.body2: His vision has supported the development of businesses covering food and beverage, automotive products, spare parts, building materials, cosmetics and other commercial activities. The continued objective is to identify new opportunities, establish strong supplier relationships and develop businesses capable of creating long-term value for customers and partners.

group.title: Premier Catering Services
group.body: Premier Projects for Food Trading and Services is established as a sister company of Premier Catering Services. This foundation provides Premier Projects with an established business mindset centered around service, reliability, customer relationships and continuous diversification.

future: Established in 2026, Premier Projects for Food Trading and Services represents the next stage of diversification and business development within the group. Our future strategy is focused on expanding the trading portfolio, strengthening international sourcing networks, developing new product categories and entering new commercial sectors.
partner: Whether you are looking for food products, automotive supplies, tyres, batteries, lubricants, building materials, cosmetics, manpower support or customized sourcing solutions, Premier Projects for Food Trading and Services is ready to explore how we can support your requirements.
